citations.quote: Only uninsured children shall be eligible for FAMIS. ... Any child covered under a group health plan or under health insurance coverage, as defined in § 2791 of the Public Health Services Act ... shall not be eligible for FAMIS.
citations.source: Virginia Administrative Code 12VAC30-141-100, General conditions of eligibility (FAMIS)

summary: Under federal CHIP law and Virginia's FAMIS rule, a child covered by a group health plan cannot be a targeted low-income child. Child 2 'has employer-sponsored insurance', and the prompt holds that coverage constant all year, so Child 2 is not CHIP/FAMIS-eligible. The answer is 0, which matches the reference. On income alone Child 2 would pass: MAGI is about $52,569, or about 192% of the 2026 FPL of $27,320, under the 200% limit plus the 5% disregard. The 15-model consensus applied only that income test and missed the uninsured requirement. The engine's narrative credits the 0 to income, which may be a misdescription, but it does not change the output the law requires on these facts. Stage 1 stands.
